wizard.title: Set up ankinote
page.soon: This page arrives later in the 1.0 rewrite.
notfound: There's no page at this address. Go to Generate.
model.intro: ankinote uses Google Gemini to write the cards, draw the pictures and record the audio. One API key is all it needs.
model.keyOptional: API key (if the service needs one)
model.keySaved: Saved key {hint}. Leave empty to keep it.
model.advanced: Use another provider, or choose models
model.advancedIntro: Each kind of content can use another provider (with its own key) or another model, and pictures and audio can be turned off. If Google isn't reachable where you are, switch card text to DeepSeek here. Anything you leave alone moves to the recommended model in new releases.
model.loadingModels: Loading the models this key can use…
model.listedNote: Pictures and audio are checked against the provider's model list, so testing costs nothing.
model.changeLater: You can change models any time in Settings → Models.
model.textFailed: Card text has to work before you can continue.
model.err.auth: {name} didn't accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
model.err.model_not_found: {name} doesn't offer {model} to this key. Choose another model in the section below.
model.err.quota: {name} says this key is out of quota or sending too many requests. Check billing on the provider's site, then test again.
model.err.timeout: The model didn't respond within 30 seconds. Select Test again to try once more.
model.err.unreachable: Couldn't reach {name}. Check the address and your network, then test again.
model.err.cannot_list: This service doesn't list its models, so the model couldn't be checked. It's saved as entered.
model.err.invalid: Something in {route} isn't filled in. Check the model and address.
model.err.server: The ankinote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then try again.
model.err.load: Couldn't load the provider list from the ankinote server. Reload the page to try again.
model.howTo.key: Sign in to Google AI Studio and create an API key.
model.howTo.billing: For pictures, turn on billing for the key's project in AI Studio. Gemini's free tier doesn't draw images; card text and audio work without billing.
model.howTo.noApis: There are no other APIs or permissions to enable: the key works as created.
model.mainUnused: Nothing uses Google now, so no Gemini key is needed.
model.billingNote: Gemini draws pictures only with billing turned on. A free-tier key passes this check, but generating a picture will fail.
model.hint.google_tts: This is a Google Cloud API key, not the AI Studio one. Enable the Cloud Text-to-Speech API in its project first.
model.err.api_disabled: The project behind this {name} key hasn't enabled the API it needs. Enable it in the Google Cloud console, then test again.
model.err.billing: {name}'s free tier can't use {model}. Turn on billing for the key's project, then test again.
anki.intro: ankinote saves your cards into an Anki collection. Choose where that collection lives.
anki.builtin.text: ankinote keeps its own collection and syncs it with AnkiWeb, so new cards reach your phone and other computers. Anki doesn't need to be open.
anki.builtin.unavailable: Not available on this system: the Anki library has no build for it. Use Anki Desktop instead.
anki.desktop.text: ankinote adds cards to Anki on this computer through the AnkiConnect add-on. Anki has to be open while you generate cards.
anki.passwordNote: Your password is sent to AnkiWeb once, to log in. ankinote keeps only the login token AnkiWeb sends back.
anki.relogin: AnkiWeb no longer accepts the saved login. Log in again to keep syncing.
anki.managed: The AnkiWeb account {account} is set by this server's configuration.
anki.sync.full: Copying the collection. A large collection can take a few minutes; you can leave this page open.
anki.sync.choice: AnkiWeb needs one more decision before the first sync.
anki.sync.credentials: AnkiWeb didn't accept the saved login.
anki.sync.backup: Couldn't back up ankinote's collection, so nothing was replaced. Check that the disk has free space, then choose again.
anki.sync.media: Cards are synced; pictures and audio haven't finished. ankinote keeps retrying by itself.
anki.sync.offline: Can't reach AnkiWeb right now. Saved cards are kept, and ankinote retries by itself.
anki.sync.offlineFirst: Can't reach AnkiWeb, so the first sync hasn't finished. ankinote retries by itself; cards can be saved once it's done.
anki.full.title: First sync
anki.full.only.download: Your cards are on AnkiWeb and ankinote's collection is still empty, so ankinote downloads them. Nothing on AnkiWeb changes.
anki.full.only.upload: AnkiWeb has no cards yet, so ankinote uploads its collection to start yours.
anki.full.both: ankinote's collection and the one on AnkiWeb both have changes that can't be merged. Choose which one to keep; the other is replaced.
anki.full.keepText.download: Downloads it and replaces the cards and review history in ankinote.
anki.full.keepText.upload: Uploads it and replaces the cards and review history on AnkiWeb.
anki.full.backup: ankinote backs up its own collection first. The copy on AnkiWeb isn't backed up.

anki.desktop.addon: In Anki, choose Tools → Add-ons → Get Add-ons, enter this code, then restart Anki:
anki.desktop.open: Keep Anki open whenever you use ankinote.

anki.types.working: Setting up note types and decks…

anki.err.other_account: This collection belongs to another AnkiWeb account. Log in with that account instead.
anki.err.managed: The AnkiWeb account is set by this server's configuration.

languages.intro: Cards teach one language and explain it in another you already know. You can change both later in Settings.
languages.nativeNote: Meanings, translations and memory hints are written in it.
languages.targetNote: Words, example sentences and audio are in it.
languages.betaNote: {lang} is in beta: its cards haven't been checked by a native reader yet, so double-check them.
languages.previewEmpty: Choose both languages to see an example.
languages.hint.native: Choose the language you know best.
languages.err.same_language: That's the language you know best. Choose another language to learn.
languages.err.not_target: ankinote can't make cards in that language yet. Choose another one.
languages.err.not_native: Cards can't be explained in that language. Choose another one.
languages.err.server: The ankinote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then try again.
languages.err.load: Couldn't load the language list from the ankinote server. Reload the page to try again.
appearance.intro: Choose the colours ankinote uses. The app changes as you pick, and you can switch any time from the top bar.
appearance.system: Your system is in {mode} mode right now.
appearance.skipNote: Skip keeps the colours you had before this step.
appearance.why.kanagawa: From Hokusai's The Great Wave off Kanagawa.
appearance.why.gruvbox: Warm retro tones, easy on the eyes.
appearance.why.rose-pine: Muted pine and rosé for a quiet, minimal look.
first.intro: Make one card to see what ankinote does. Try the suggested word or type your own, check the preview, then save it to Anki.
first.patience: Text comes first, then audio and a picture. It usually takes 20–60 seconds.
first.previewEmpty: The card's preview shows up here.
first.where: Goes to the {deck} deck as an “{type}” note.
sync.done: Synced with AnkiWeb. Your other devices get it at their next sync.
sync.pending: Syncing with AnkiWeb in the background.
sync.error: Saved here, but syncing with AnkiWeb didn't finish. ankinote tries again on its own.
first.hint: Save a card to finish setup.
gap.image.not_set_up: No image: no image model is set up. You can add one in Settings → Models.
gap.image.failed: No image: the image model failed ({detail}).
gap.audio.not_set_up: No audio: no speech model is set up. You can add one in Settings → Models.
gap.audio.failed: No audio: the speech model failed ({detail}).
first.gen.no_text_model: No text model is set up. Go back to step 1 and connect one.
first.gen.bad_output: The model's answer couldn't be read as a card. Select Generate again; if it keeps happening, try another text model.
first.gen.timeout: Generating took more than 3 minutes and was stopped. Select Generate to try again.
first.gen.auth: The text model's provider didn't accept the key. Check it in step 1.
first.gen.quota: The text model's provider says the key is out of quota or sending too many requests. Wait a moment or check billing, then try again.
first.gen.billing: This text model needs billing turned on for the key's project. Turn it on, or choose another model in step 1.
first.gen.model_not_found: The provider doesn't offer the text model to this key. Choose another model in step 1.
first.gen.api_disabled: The key's Google project hasn't enabled the API it needs. Enable it in the Google Cloud console, then try again.
first.gen.unreachable: Couldn't reach the model's provider. Check your network, then try again.
first.gen.server: The ankinote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then try again.
first.save.write_blocked: AnkiWeb needs attention before cards can be saved. Go back to Connect Anki to finish it; this card is kept, so you can save it afterwards.
first.save.unreachable: Anki Desktop isn't answering. Open Anki, then select Save to Anki again.
first.save.not_open: Anki isn't connected. Go back to Connect Anki.
first.save.draft_gone: This preview is gone because the ankinote server restarted. Select Generate again.
first.save.server: The ankinote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then select Save to Anki again.
first.save.error: Saving to Anki failed ({detail}). Select Save to Anki to try again.
edit.title: Edit — {text}
edit.intro: Changes apply to this card only. A changed example sentence gets new audio; the word itself can't be changed here — generate it again instead.
edit.applying: Applying… changed sentences get new audio, which can take a few seconds.
edit.where: Nothing reaches Anki until you save.
edit.err.blankRow: Every {field} row needs all its parts filled in, or remove the row.
edit.err.too_long: {field} is too long for a card.
edit.err.audio_not_set_up: A changed sentence needs new audio, but no speech model is set up. Add one in Settings → Models, or keep the sentence as it was.
edit.err.audio_failed: Couldn't make audio for the changed sentence ({detail}). Nothing was changed; select Apply to try again.
edit.err.timeout: Making the new audio took too long and was stopped. Select Apply to try again.
edit.err.draft_gone: This preview is gone because the ankinote server restarted. Select Cancel, then Regenerate.
edit.err.server: The ankinote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then select Apply again.
